nodes.name: _ui_impacts_partial
nodes.summary: Renders the impacts HTML partial for an amendment, used for HTMX swaps.

nodes.name: _ui_changes_partial
nodes.summary: Renders the changes HTML partial for an amendment, used for HTMX swaps.

nodes.name: _ui_geo_scopes_partial
nodes.summary: Renders the geographic-scopes HTML partial for an amendment, used for HTMX swaps.

nodes.name: _ui_geo_scopes_and_deps
nodes.summary: Renders the geographic-scopes partial together with its dependent governance-date links, used after scope changes that affect linked dates.

nodes.name: _ui_enrollments_partial
nodes.summary: Renders the subject-enrollments HTML partial for an amendment, used for HTMX swaps.

nodes.name: _ui_gov_dates_partial
nodes.summary: Renders the governance-dates HTML partial for an amendment, used for HTMX swaps.

nodes.name: ui_add_secondary_reason
nodes.summary: UI form endpoint adding a secondary reason to an amendment, returning the refreshed reasons partial.

nodes.name: ui_delete_secondary_reason
nodes.summary: UI form endpoint deleting a secondary reason, returning the refreshed reasons partial.

nodes.name: ui_update_reason
nodes.summary: UI form endpoint updating a secondary reason's code/text, returning the refreshed reasons partial.

nodes.name: ui_add_impact
nodes.summary: UI form endpoint adding an impact record to an amendment, returning the refreshed impacts partial.

nodes.name: ui_delete_impact
nodes.summary: UI form endpoint deleting an impact record, returning the refreshed impacts partial.

nodes.name: ui_update_impact
nodes.summary: UI form endpoint updating an impact record's type/text/substantiality flag, returning the refreshed impacts partial.

nodes.name: ui_add_change
nodes.summary: UI form endpoint adding a protocol change record to an amendment, returning the refreshed changes partial.

nodes.name: ui_delete_change
nodes.summary: UI form endpoint deleting a protocol change record, returning the refreshed changes partial.

nodes.name: ui_update_change
nodes.summary: UI form endpoint updating a protocol change's summary/rationale/label/description, returning the refreshed changes partial.

nodes.name: ui_add_section
nodes.summary: UI form endpoint linking a protocol section reference to a change, returning the refreshed changes partial.

nodes.name: ui_delete_section
nodes.summary: UI form endpoint unlinking a protocol section reference from a change, returning the refreshed changes partial.

nodes.name: ui_geo_scope_location_options
nodes.summary: Renders the location dropdown options (countries or regions) for a given geographic-scope type code.

nodes.name: ui_add_geographic_scope
nodes.summary: UI form endpoint adding a geographic scope to an amendment, returning the refreshed geo-scopes partial.

nodes.name: ui_delete_geographic_scope
nodes.summary: UI form endpoint deleting a geographic scope from an amendment, returning the refreshed geo-scopes-and-dependents partial.

nodes.name: ui_update_geographic_scope
nodes.summary: UI form endpoint updating a geographic scope's type/location, returning the refreshed geo-scopes partial.

nodes.name: ui_add_enrollment
nodes.summary: UI form endpoint adding a subject enrollment record to an amendment, returning the refreshed enrollments partial.

nodes.name: ui_delete_enrollment
nodes.summary: UI form endpoint deleting a subject enrollment record, returning the refreshed enrollments partial.

nodes.name: ui_update_enrollment
nodes.summary: UI form endpoint updating a subject enrollment record's quantity/label/scope fields, returning the refreshed enrollments partial.

nodes.name: ui_add_governance_date
nodes.summary: UI form endpoint adding a governance date to an amendment, optionally linking it to geographic scopes, returning the refreshed governance-dates partial.

nodes.name: ui_delete_governance_date
nodes.summary: UI form endpoint deleting a governance date from an amendment, returning the refreshed governance-dates partial.

nodes.name: ui_update_governance_date
nodes.summary: UI form endpoint updating a governance date's type/value/label/description, returning the refreshed governance-dates partial.

nodes.name: ui_link_gov_date_scope
nodes.summary: UI form endpoint linking a geographic scope to a governance date, returning the refreshed governance-dates partial.

nodes.name: ui_unlink_gov_date_scope
nodes.summary: UI form endpoint unlinking a geographic scope from a governance date, returning the refreshed governance-dates partial.

nodes.name: audits.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI router rendering a single combined audit-trail history page that aggregates before/after change records across every auditable entity type in a SoA.

nodes.name: ui_list_audits
nodes.summary: Renders the combined audit-trail page for a SoA, querying and merging before/after change history across every auditable entity type (arms, elements, visits, activities, cells, timings, timelines, instances, BCs, amendments, and more) into a single chronological view.

nodes.name: bc_categories.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI router for assigning and removing CDISC BC (Biomedical Concept) classification categories on an activity, expanding a category into its constituent concepts on assignment.

nodes.name: _expand_category_to_activity
nodes.summary: Expands a CDISC BC classification category into its constituent biomedical concepts and links each one to the given activity, upserting BiomedicalConcept rows as needed.

nodes.name: ui_add_category_to_activity
nodes.summary: UI endpoint that assigns a CDISC classification category to an activity, triggering background expansion into concept associations.

nodes.name: ui_remove_category_from_activity
nodes.summary: UI endpoint that removes a previously-assigned CDISC classification category from an activity.

nodes.name: dair.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI router serving the Digital Amendment Impact Report (DAIR) UI page and its downloadable DOCX report comparing a base and revised freeze.

nodes.name: ui_dair
nodes.summary: Renders the DAIR (Digital Amendment Impact Report) UI page, listing available freezes for the SoA so the user can pick a base and revised freeze to compare.

nodes.name: download_dair
nodes.summary: Streams a generated DAIR DOCX report comparing a base and revised freeze back to the client as a file download, delegating report construction to `usdm.generate_dair.build_dair`.

nodes.name: freezes.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI router exposing the freeze lifecycle (list, create with optional amendment metadata, view, diff, rollback, delete) as thin HTTP endpoints over `_freeze_helpers` and `amendments` internals.

nodes.name: ui_list_freezes
nodes.summary: Renders the list of freezes captured for a SoA.

nodes.name: ui_freeze_soa
nodes.summary: Creates a new freeze snapshot of the current SoA state and, when marked as an amendment, also creates the associated StudyAmendment record (reason, label, description) linked to the new freeze.

nodes.name: get_freeze
nodes.summary: API endpoint returning a single freeze's stored snapshot data as JSON.

nodes.name: ui_freeze_view
nodes.summary: Renders a read-only modal view of a single freeze's snapshot.

nodes.name: ui_freeze_diff
nodes.summary: Renders a diff view between two freezes (or a freeze and the live study), limited to a manageable number of changed entities per section.

nodes.name: ui_freeze_rollback
nodes.summary: Rolls the live study back to match a prior freeze's snapshot, restoring entity state.

nodes.name: ui_freeze_rollback_preview
nodes.summary: Renders a preview of what a rollback to a given freeze would change before the user confirms it.

nodes.name: ui_freeze_delete
nodes.summary: Deletes a freeze snapshot and its stored entity data.

nodes.name: get_freeze_diff_json
nodes.summary: API endpoint returning the full (unlimited) diff between two freezes as JSON, used by the DAIR generator and other programmatic consumers.

nodes.name: organizations.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI router implementing CRUD for study Organization entities, including organization-type and country controlled-terminology code management and structured address fields.

nodes.name: _next_org_uid
nodes.summary: Generates the next monotonic Organization UID for a SoA.

nodes.name: _get_org_type_options
nodes.summary: Loads the organization-type controlled-terminology dropdown options for the organization form.

nodes.name: _get_countries_options
nodes.summary: Loads the country controlled-terminology dropdown options for organization address fields.

nodes.name: _list_organizations
nodes.summary: Fetches all Organization rows for a SoA joined with their type/country codes and address fields.

nodes.name: _row_to_dict
nodes.summary: Converts an Organization database row into a plain dict for template rendering and JSON responses.

nodes.name: _insert_type_code
nodes.summary: Inserts a Code row recording an organization's type controlled-terminology value.

nodes.name: _insert_country_code
nodes.summary: Inserts a Code row recording an organization address's country value.

nodes.name: _ddf_ct_version
nodes.summary: Resolves the DDF controlled-terminology package version used for organization/country code lookups.

nodes.name: list_organizations
nodes.summary: API endpoint returning all organizations for a SoA as JSON.

nodes.name: create_organization
nodes.summary: API endpoint creating a new Organization record with its address and controlled-terminology type/country codes.

nodes.name: delete_organization
nodes.summary: API endpoint deleting an Organization and its associated code rows, guarding against dependent role references.
